submittedPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: original local contact/receiving-material selection markup, STEP S1, for FIXED included joint layer.
The ONLY input is the exact root-approved complete Soyo LISTENING mist mother, 1536x1024. Preserve original full canvas, camera, all furniture and every source coordinate. This is selection markup for unchanged SOURCE RGB, not a new person, another pose, new shadow, color correction, mask from a template or portable body/caster. Output the original 1536x1024 canvas with no crop, resize, zoom, centering, movement, text, arrows, grid or outline.
Keep the entire person, empty hands, complete hair, all clothing/hem/socks/shoes and the separate closed book in their ORIGINAL COLOR. Paint PURE SOLID WHITE only over existing SMALL LOCAL RECEIVER patches caused by this body/book and these shoes, at their exact original source positions. Follow real irregular linen compression/contact and short local floor shade, never invent a shadow or use rectangles/ellipses.
Seat receiver: select only the actual little visible linen/contact islands right below the skirt/hip in these tight neighborhoods: tiny left trailing-hem receiver near x805..871,y552..594 and rear-hip/right-hem receiver near x1040..1150,y568..617. These are loose inspection neighborhoods, NOT fill boxes. The garment itself remains colored (it belongs to F), and the EMPTY LONG CUSHION STRIP to either side stays colored. Do not connect the small islands into a long white seat band.
Book receiver: only the tiny actual linen strip immediately touching the underside of the separate closed book, closed-book bottom receiver near x1131..1280,y566..586; the entire book remains colored.
Sole receivers: only the immediate actual floor contacts/short shade touching the two complete source loafer bottoms, image-left sole near x740..837,y853..905 and image-right sole near x799..938,y879..929. Keep every dark shoe sidewall/sole/heel in original color; shoes belong to F. Do not move floor shade downwards, connect the two into one broad oval, or select unrelated wood-floor sunlight/lamp highlights.
All other source RGB stays unchanged, including the face/hair/bow/left-chest crest, hands/knees, skirt folds and dark hem, every shoe, the book, naturally pale linen/pillows, full curtains/flowers/lamp shade, window, floor/rug and furniture. Self-shading on the person and book is not a receiver. No whole bench, bright floor rectangle, sun-window lattice or generic cast shadow selection. Output one opaque full-color original-position 1536x1024 PNG with only those few actual local receiver regions deliberately white. This is included source receiving material, not an independent transferable shadow.
